<thought>Based on the ESI mass spectrum, the most intense ion is at m/z 180.0423, which corresponds to the [M+H]⁺ ion. Subtracting the mass of a proton (1.007276 Da) gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈179.035 Da. The formula that best matches this exact mass while fitting the observed isotopic pattern (≈10 % M+1 intensity, indicating ~9–10 carbons) is C₉H₉NO₃.</thought>
<final_answer>C9H9NO3</final_answer>
